subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should the Dashboard keep a persistent breadcrumb/header surface for active agent plus workspace context, or should the newer header/topbar cleanup direction provide this multi-agent safety affordance somewhere else?
rationale: The source-backed gap remains, but the final UI placement overlaps with both the focused closing PR and the open maintainer-authored header cleanup PR.

options.title: Land focused workspace breadcrumb
options.body: Rebase and review the focused PR, then close this issue when the persistent agent/workspace context lands and track optional switcher/prefix ideas separately.

options.title: Fold into header cleanup
options.body: Require the header cleanup PR to preserve an equivalent persistent agent/workspace safety affordance before replacing the breadcrumb path.

options.title: Broaden this issue
options.body: Keep this issue open for the larger switch-feedback, live-target proof, and optional quick-switch/prefix UX rather than closing on a focused breadcrumb.

recommendation.title: Land focused workspace breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Rebase and review the focused PR, then close this issue when the persistent agent/workspace context lands and track optional switcher/prefix ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Their active header/topbar PR is the current product-direction fork for whether breadcrumbs remain the persistent context surface.
